method: Complete GitHub recursive tree (truncated=false) plus source inspection of all 104 registry entries, all dedicated research routes, public maps, hubs, source registry, sitemap and metadata. Implementation status is repository-verified; this file does not certify HTTP/rendered production behavior.

global_defects.finding: 103 domain URLs deliberately render a review notice rather than the legacy generated prose. Public source registry is empty.
global_defects.resolution: Publish bounded evidence-ready dossiers; keep the remainder explicitly held.

global_defects.finding: Public map, legacy domain sourceCount, approved source registry and route status are separate records. Hub counts use legacy sourceCount while card counts use the empty approved registry. Four domains vanish from hubs.
global_defects.resolution: One publication registry should own reviewed status, source memberships, dates, cards, counts, source browser, sitemap and RSS.

global_defects.finding: Research RSS has no item elements and says publication is paused.
global_defects.resolution: Populate only reviewed releases using source-controlled publication/modified dates.

global_defects.finding: 104 topics dominate discovery while only one domain is a dedicated dataset route. Search indexes titles and categories; evidence status and usable outputs are not search filters.
global_defects.resolution: Lead with reviewed research; distinguish reviewed dossiers from topic maps, provide method/source filters and contextual reading paths.

global_defects.evidence: app/sitemap.ts: researchPages, hub entries and discovered route loop
global_defects.finding: Catch-all placeholders are correctly excluded, but many explicit research pages receive currentDate lastModified and hubs use a hard-coded 2026-09-13.
global_defects.resolution: Use actual editorial modified dates. Add reviewed releases through publication registry; preserve noindex exclusions.

global_defects.finding: Older dedicated pages declare apex frankx.ai while current routes use www.frankx.ai; Visual Catalog inherits /research canonical.
global_defects.resolution: Normalize to verified site canonical host; give each indexable page its own canonical, title, description and supported schema.

global_defects.finding: Many legacy sourceCount, evidenceGrade, lastVerified and mechanistic claims are not supported by the empty public source registry. Page-level A/B/C labels cannot establish individual claim validity.
global_defects.resolution: Render typed, atomic claims with source, locator, as-of, limitations and independent verdict. Separate vendor documentation from independent empirical results.

overlap_groups.decision: Keep both URLs. Make the first empirical benchmark/task-trajectory evidence; reserve agentic-evals for life-agent conformance, deletion, portability and intervention tests.
Separate memory mechanisms from life-memory portability and consent. Link contextual distinctions; do not republish the same vendor survey twice.
Own execution isolation on sandbox page; identity/export/deletion on sovereignty page; MCP authorization on protocol security page; threat taxonomy on OWASP page.

Own package interoperability and activation on agent skills page; enterprise adoption assessment on maturity page. Explicitly label L0–L5 as FrankX taxonomy unless a primary standards source supports it.

Lifecycle synthesis owns product development; coding owns issue-to-reviewed-patch execution; foundry owns repeatable venture experiments; knowledge engines owns publishable knowledge products; content ops owns evidence-to-distribution workflow.

proof_waves.promotion: Each dossier requires claim review and rendered preview. Expand beyond the proof wave after independent editorial review and measured reader behavior.
